hooks.required: Initialize _extended_tone=S.default(); add field to DOC_FIELDS, empty/capture/apply state; call host.sync after pipeline reattach using verified proxy/source ratio and actual monochrome flag. Do not add controller owner to persisted state.

Expose cmd_extended_tone via host.controller(...).handle(p), cmd_extended_tone_receipt returning controller.query(p[request_id]); advertise protocol only when fixed ABI library installed AND hooks wired; add doc_state extended_tone=S.status(...). Receipt query is read-only.

Use controller-owned history commit. Do NOT add extended_tone to automatic dispatch EDIT_CMDS; otherwise duplicate history. Add allowed command routing without automatic record. Existing generic signature captures recipe once DOC_FIELDS/capture hooked.

Initialize/reset ExtendedToneStage; run apply_t on float32 full-frame display-sRGB output directly after exposure and before levels/curves. Never cast to half. Determine exact matching export boundary before enabling controls.

Add ExportSpec.extended_tone; validate snapshot; force floating intermediate when active. Split full-frame upstream exposure assembly from downstream levels/curves; call render_export_full_frame exactly once at the matching boundary. Do not call per tile or only after all color stages.
Pass _extended_tone in every snapshot, including queued/nonactive documents; configure_export expects internal-key snapshot. Pass monochrome from each target, not active document.

Add recipe to all allowlists/new-document defaults; call validate_records during decode/encode and restore through typed checker. Old documents missing field default neutral; unknown version rejects, never drops.

Register independent extended_tone module. preset_export/preset_apply and batch_replace prepare validated copies; existing all-or-none document group transaction owns mutation/history. Mask-bearing requests must not be silently treated as global.

Route send and result/receipt events with exact request_id and document_id. extendedToneTransport requires subscribe/send implementation, not a Promise that resolves on send acknowledgment. Surface errors and capability-disabled reason.

Mount ExtendedTonePanel with live doc_state, verified native/integration readiness, monochrome flag, document ID, send/query and refresh callbacks. Preserve unresolved request handling across remount; supply explicit reload/reconcile flow for engine restart unknown receipts.
Register seven full handbook IDs only after all shared hooks and tests pass. Each ID is SOURCE_CONNECTED_UNRUN after this grant. Do not claim visual acceptance.
Explicitly invoke authored build script and include exact liblrt_extended_tone.so ABI 2 in distribution. No auto-build on import; missing native must disable UI with reason.

actual_export: Exposure-only full-frame float prepass -> one Rust operation -> tile halo override at same exposure boundary -> existing downstream effects -> final original monochrome mode -> quantization.
monochrome: Explicit persisted original output mode, not external profile/XMP support.
